titles.src/core/client/mp.js: core: the page's network and dread layer opens (the IIFE): its imports, page elements, connection, snapshot and entity-slot state
titles.src/frameworks/bpp/client/mp.net.js: B++: window.__net, what the game bundle calls (the fixed-step tick, join, respawn, leave, NEW RUN's press)
titles.src/frameworks/gib/client/mp.owndeath.js: G.I.B.: our own death, from the server's kill record (window.__dvic)
titles.src/frameworks/bpp/client/mp.newrun.js: B++: NEW RUN's state on this page, and the server's answers (nrAnswer)
titles.src/frameworks/space/client/mp.peers.js: S.P.A.C.E.: the other living Wanderers are solid, the soft correction, the world epoch
titles.src/frameworks/bpp/client/mp.transport.j: B++: the WebSocket: sending (tx), connecting, and every message the server sends
titles.src/frameworks/nani/client/mp.monsters.j: N.A.N.I.: the server's monsters, mirrored into the game
titles.src/frameworks/lost/client/mp.glitch.js: L.O.S.T.: the glitched walls: touching one takes you out of Level 0
titles.src/frameworks/pocket/client/mp.cartogra: P.O.C.K.E.T.: the cartograph, one rare item per world
titles.src/frameworks/gib/client/mp.bodies.js: G.I.B.: everyone's bodies, one per player
Spacious Audio: the dread's sound (the drone and the heartbeat)
BR-R: the other Wanderers: their hover names and avatars' clean-up
titles.src/frameworks/gib/client/mp.replays.js: G.I.B.: other players' deaths and vanishings, replayed for everybody in line of sight
titles.src/frameworks/overseer/client/mp.deathl: OVERSEER: the death lab (window.__dlab: the clock, the x-ray, the overlay)
titles.src/core/client/mp.frame.js: core: the per-frame hook the game calls (the network send, the other Wanderers drawn, the dread); the IIFE closes here

src/frameworks/bpp/client/mp.net.js: OVERSEER's admin state (adm) and the peers map are declared just before it, as they always were.
src/frameworks/space/client/mp.peers.js: B++'s fresher poses (peerPoses, Stage 3E-0 B+) sit between the solid peers and the soft correction, as they always did.
